title: GitHub & Vercel integrations › Interfere
summary: GitHub and Vercel install in one click, and each surface maps to a repository and a Vercel project.
body_markdown:
Interfere traces a problem back to the release that caused it, which means we need to know what code and what deployment sit behind each part of your product. We’ve added GitHub and Vercel integrations, both available with one-click installs from the new Integrations page.


Once connected, each surface can be mapped to a GitHub repository and Vercel project. Problems now include the Vercel project and the deployment that was live when the failure started, so the release that introduced the problem is attached from the moment it opens.


We’ve also reworked onboarding into a single flow where you set everything up: create your workspace, configure your surface, connect your repository and deployment platform.
